content: Common pattern for slot-based booking: store recurring availability as rules (e.g. StylistAvailability: DayOfWeek + start/end time, or explicit date-range overrides) rather than materializing every future slot; compute open slots on read by generating candidate slots from the rule for the requested date range and subtracting existing bookings' time ranges (interval-overlap check) for that stylist; index Bookings by (StylistId, StartTime) for fast overlap queries; avoid storing a row per generated slot to prevent unbounded table growth.
